name: Crypto Web Crypto Playground
description: Browser-side cryptographic playground. The page registers five WebMCP tools via navigator.modelContext (list_algorithms, compute_digest, generate_keys, encrypt_or_sign, decrypt_or_verify) and exposes the same operations to an in-app AI chat using the OpenAI function-calling protocol. All handlers are pure client-side Web Crypto calls: read-only, idempotent, no network access.

tools.name: list_algorithms
tools.description: List all supported cryptographic algorithms with methods, key lengths and generation flags

tools.name: compute_digest
tools.description: Hash text into a hex digest (SHA-1/256/384/512)

tools.name: generate_keys
tools.description: Generate a symmetric key or public/private key pair as hex strings

tools.name: encrypt_or_sign
tools.description: Encrypt text (AES/RSA-OAEP) or produce a digital signature/MAC (RSASSA, RSA-PSS, ECDSA, HMAC)

tools.name: decrypt_or_verify
tools.description: Decrypt ciphertext (AES/RSA-OAEP) or verify a signature/MAC
